title: SrTiO3: relax, bands and DOS
description: A five-atom perovskite with a relaxed cell, 353-point band path and element-resolved DOS.
goal: Relax SrTiO3, then calculate PBE bands and DOS.
source: VASP 5.4.4 on Slurm, 10 October 2026. PBE, 520 eV and an 8x8x8 SCF mesh.
note: Cluster labels and paths use placeholders. Inputs and numerical results are unchanged. This is not a convergence benchmark.
